638f878b44.q: What are the three core pillars of DScreened's approach to digital balance?
638f878b44.a: DScreened focuses on three modes of digital balance solvency: first, education where they educate peers on how to achieve better digital balance; second, building a community around young people so they have support when they need help with digital balance; and third, working on advocacy and policy to affect a larger scale of people not directly involved with the organization.

1c4188acbf.q: How did the Texas school phone ban law impact the founding of DScreened?
1c4188acbf.a: During their junior year, a statewide school phone ban law signed by Governor Abbott was implemented across their school. The team observed how intensely students struggled to stay away from their phones, with some receiving disciplinary records, in-school suspensions, and out-of-school suspensions for violating the ban—demonstrating that the phone addiction problem was severe enough to warrant intervention beyond enforcement.

0773141b4b.q: What was DScreened's first event and how many people attended?
0773141b4b.a: DScreened's very first event was a pickleball event hosted in 2024, which had about 40 people show up. The organization did not mandate phone-free participation, but instead designed the event to be so engaging and personalized that attendees naturally chose to put their phones away rather than constantly scroll while they could be doing something fun.

eeeafcbc5f.q: What specific screen time limits has Bidemi Ologunde (the host) set on his personal devices?
eeeafcbc5f.a: Bidemi has set social media apps on his phone to a 15-minute daily limit. When the 15 minutes is up, the phone offers options to extend, but he has trained himself over the past six years to consistently decline extension and simply close the app, to the point where some days he doesn't even remember to use the app.

e425a7ce35.q: How many events has DScreened hosted globally to promote digital balance?

Local chapters in different locations can host their own events, and when they do, they typically have a large number of people showing up who are genuinely interested in the mission.
